face_corner_lineage_reconstruction.method: source face + saved barycentric weights; outer/inner cylinders compared in locally unwrapped (R*theta,z) chart using periodic angle difference; planar/base faces compared in rest XYZ

triangle_quality_definitions.3d_geometry: candidate relief vertex coordinates and straight triangle chords; geometric mesh descriptor, not a mechanics or fracture measure
triangle_quality_definitions.cylinder_chart: intrinsic local chart metric with shortest periodic angular deltas and arc length radius*delta_theta, combined with z

triangle_group_definitions.body: outer source face with all three saved outer relief heights exactly zero
triangle_group_definitions.support: outer source face with all three saved outer relief heights strictly positive
triangle_group_definitions.transition: outer source face with both zero and positive saved outer relief heights at its corners
triangle_group_definitions.inner: source face whose three baseline vertices are all in baseline inner_side_vertex_indices
triangle_group_definitions.base: remaining non-outer and non-inner source faces, including planar rims/floor/caps
